hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in "$root"/api/src/*.ts) (cd "$root/api" && "$root/node_modules/.bin/biome" check --write "$f") ;; "$root"/web/src/*.ts|"$root"/web/src/*.tsx) (cd "$root/web" && "$root/node_modules/.bin/biome" check --write "$f") ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in "$root"/web/src/i18n/locales/en.json) jq -n '{systemMessage:"en.json changed \u2014 remember to sync the other 32 locales (npm run check:locales in web/, or call the translator agent) before this is considered done."}' ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '\bgit\s+commit\b'; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Direct commits to main/dev are blocked by project convention (conventions.md) - commit on a feature/fix/chore/docs branch and open a PR."}}'; fi; fi
